name: Copilot Environment Setup

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  # Trigger on push to main to keep environment updated
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'pubspec.yaml'
      - 'packages/**/pubspec.yaml'
      - '.github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read
  # Required for the setup action to copy files to the agent environment
  id-token: write

jobs:
  setup-copilot-environment:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Dart SDK
        uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - name: Setup Flutter SDK
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          flutter-version: "3.24.0" # Use a stable version compatible with your Dart SDK
          channel: "stable"
          cache: true

      - name: Verify Dart and Flutter installation
        run: |
          dart --version
          flutter --version

      - name: Resolve workspace dependencies
        run: dart pub get

      - name: Setup Copilot Agent Environment
        uses: githubnext/gh-aw/actions/setup@v0.36.0
        with:
          destination: .github/copilot-instructions.md
